text:
Alice M.: Heads up — saw a spike in sampled request payloads from /v1/chat/completions tonight. Sample rate briefly was 100% for ~60s, which exposed PII in logs. Need burst protection ASAP.
Ben L.: Can you paste route + timeframe?
Alice M.: route: /v1/chat/completions, ~2026-03-21T21:00Z. Logs show repeated user emails in request.user and name fields.
Carla R.: We currently have per-route sample_rate but no burst limiter. Propose token-bucket + max_burst_tokens + automatic pseudonymize fallback for high-burst events.
Dave P.: Agreed. Also want a console quick-toggle for canary->global flips, plus required reason + TTL in audit logs when you flip redaction/unredact.
Monica S.: UX note: require a reason and an expiry on any temp-unmask action. Prevents permanent unredact by accident.
Ben L.: Sketch config idea:
```
routes:
  "/v1/chat/completions":
    sample_rate: 0.01
    burst_limit: 100
    pseudonymize: hmac-sha256
    inspect_ttl: 600
```
Alice M.: If we use `hmac-sha256` with a per-tenant salt in KMS, we can preserve a reversible mapping only if we keep the salt accessible to HSM. Alternatively one-way hash for non-reversible needs different audit model.
Carla R.: Right — we should support both: `pseudonymize: reversible|one-way` and default to reversible with HSM + strict audit. Add opt-out for tenants that need raw context for downstream evals (with contract).
Dave P.: Ops: this affects rerankers/evals that assume raw text. Need transformation chain in the console so customers can opt into `keep-raw-for-eval` where we store raw in encrypted vault.
Monica S.: Console proposal: show two controls per-route — sampling % slider and burst cap input. Add a "safe mode" toggle that forces pseudonymize when burst > X. Display a small CTA explaining impact on downstream features.
Alice M.: We also need auto-mitigation: if `sample_rate * rps` for a pii-labeled route exceeds threshold, auto-reduce sample_rate to 0.1% and alert security + route owner.
Ben L.: We can emit a telemetry metric `sampled_pii_qps` and an alert when > 1.0. Also compute expected sample qps from `rps * sample_rate` and compare on the control plane.
Carla R.: Add tracing tag `sampler.decision={rate|burst|forced-pseudonymize}` on spans for auditability. Also capture `pseudonymize:method` in logs. @Dave P.
Dave P.: Good. Rollout plan: canary to 1% for 24h, monitor `sampled_pii_qps`, `unredact_count`, error rates, then 10% for next 48h, etc.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for sampler-service v3.2.1 -> 10% of ingress :rocket:
Alice M.: Thanks — I'll open a micro-RFC with the config schema and console mock. Assigning @Ben L. for limiter + telemetry and @Carla R. for redaction/KMS design.
Ben L.: On it — prototyping token-bucket limiter + telemetry today.
Carla R.: I'll draft KMS integration and security review checklist.
Monica S.: :thumbsup:
